style.prompt: Create an 8-second widescreen 16:9 charming cartoon animation. A little orange robot with a round friendly face and small articulated arms gently waters a green leafy plant in a terracotta pot using a little watering can. Cozy pastel garden setting, clean playful cartoon shapes, warm soft light. One continuous locked-off medium-wide shot; robot and entire pot stay visible. Robot slowly tilts watering can, a gentle stream of water lands in the soil, then the robot returns the can upright and smiles at the plant. Smooth restrained movement and consistent characters and objects. IMPORTANT: Display the exact title text 'Small steps' centered at the top of the screen for the entire video, from the very first frame to the very last frame, in large crisp dark rounded letters on a clean light background area, stable and unchanged, easy to read, no other text. Keep the action below the title. Silent video: no sound, no speech, no music.
